issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Man Sentenced to 120 Months' Imprisonment for Role in Bribing a Juror During Feeding Our Future Trial
supports: Abdiaziz Shafii Farah was sentenced on 2026-07-22 to 120 months' imprisonment for attempting to bribe a federal juror during his 2024 Feeding Our Future fraud trial.
USAO-MN published the sentencing release on 2026-07-24.
The release identifies Ladan Mohamed Ali, Abdulkarim Shafii Farah, Said Shafii Farah, and Abdimajid Mohamed Nur as associates in the juror-bribery plot described by the government.
does_not_support: Do not merge the 120-month juror-bribery sentence with Abdiaziz Farah's separate 2025 Feeding Our Future fraud sentence as though they were one judgment or one offense.
This release does not by itself establish how the two prison terms run relative to each other; use the judgment for concurrency/consecutiveness if needed.
notes: Closes the older research gap that treated the July 2026 juror-bribery sentence as journalism-led because an official USAO release had not yet been captured.
